title: Beyond the 956: Helena Bianco, voice of Los Mismos and 'La Voz Senior' winner, dies at 78
excerpt: Helena Bianco, the Spanish singer who led the 1960s pop group Los Mismos and won the first season of 'La Voz Senior' in 2019, has died at 78. She died Thursday, November 12, 2026, in Madrid after a battle with neuroendocrine cancer, her brother confirmed.
content:
🌎 BEYOND THE 956

Helena Bianco, the Spanish singer who was the voice of the 1960s pop group Los Mismos and the winner of the first season of La Voz Senior, has died at 78.

Bianco died on Thursday, November 12, 2026, in Madrid, after a battle with an aggressive neuroendocrine cancer, her brother, the artist Alberto Vázquez, confirmed. She was 78.

Born Elena Vázquez Minguela in Valladolid on January 6, 1948, Bianco became one of the most recognizable voices of Spanish popular music as the lead singer of Los Mismos, the group behind the beloved hit “El puente,” a soundtrack to a generation in the 1960s and 1970s.

After decades away from the spotlight, she returned to national fame in 2019, winning the first edition of La Voz Senior in Spain. She kept performing into her late seventies, with her final concert on September 15, 2026, in Bembibre, León.

Her illness became public in early November, when her team announced she had cancer and would undergo chemotherapy, cancelling her upcoming concerts. Her brother later said the diagnosis had come about nine months earlier and described the cancer as tough, aggressive and resistant to treatment.

Her funeral is set for Tuesday, November 17, at the Cathedral of Valladolid, her hometown, which is also preparing to name a street in her honor.

Rest in Peace, Helena Bianco.

Sources: El País; LOS40; AS.
